craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of marshalled examples — parity and fencing. Khadira proof by mere-knowing; afar kept (distance is the wonder). Rejected: (a) grove→forest → killed: grove is exact. Read aloud: AS from a-FAR … AS kha-DI-ra-WOOD.

lines: As from afar, from smoke, proof comes in the khadira grove —
fire stands proved by knowing it: as khadira-wood.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yathā vā dūrato dhūmātsiddhiḥ khadirakānane vahnistatpratipattyaiva khādiratvena siddhyati

reads_against.argmap: How is fire proved as khadira-wood? → Fire is proved as khadira-wood by mere knowing: the stock example turned for fitness.
c1_essence: Stock examples turned: eye-fitness shows the higher self; smoke-fire proves khadira-wood by mere knowing (vv10-11).
The hetu fenced, others sifting, the whole Lord-made; helpers' strange way opened, pictured, and bounded; fancied spread refused (vv12-18).
